rpgmod.gui.heating: Heating: stop the bar to set the starting heat
rpgmod.gui.heating_hint: Right = hotter (stronger, slower bar) / Left = cooler
rpgmod.gui.strike_hint: Click or Space to strike (centre = strongest)
rpgmod.message.inventory_full: Your inventory was full, so it was dropped at your feet
rpgmod.job.fighter.desc: A front-line warrior with swords and hammers. High health and attack, strong area attacks and charges.
rpgmod.job.ranger.desc: A master archer who keeps moving, firing volleys and setting snares.
rpgmod.job.paladin.desc: A holy knight with mace and sword. Very sturdy; protects and heals allies.
rpgmod.job.wizard.desc: Sets spells on a staff. Hold V to switch spells, right-click to cast.
rpgmod.job.healer.desc: Supports the party with staff and mace: healing, regeneration and mana gifts.
rpgmod.job.assassin.desc: A dagger fighter with high critical chance, blinking and stealth.
rpgmod.job.enchanter.desc: Shapes the fight with staff and dagger: empowers allies and weakens foes.
rpgmod.job.gambler.desc: Uses daggers and bows. Skill results are random — jackpots and busts.
rpgmod.skill.power_slash.desc: Cleave a wide arc in front of you (4.5 blocks).
rpgmod.skill.charge.desc: Dash forward, knocking aside enemies in your way.
rpgmod.skill.war_cry.desc: Give strength to nearby allies and weaken nearby enemies.
rpgmod.skill.whirlwind.desc: Spin twice, striking everything around you.
rpgmod.skill.berserk.desc: Greatly raise strength and speed for a while.
rpgmod.skill.earthshatter.desc: Smash the ground: a spreading shockwave hits, lifts and slows enemies.
rpgmod.skill.multishot.desc: Fire three arrows in a fan.
rpgmod.skill.backstep.desc: Leap backwards with a burst of speed.
rpgmod.skill.hunters_mark.desc: Scans 128 blocks around you: every hostile monster glows for 12s, visible through walls.
rpgmod.skill.snare.desc: Throw a snare where you aim; it roots enemies that enter.
rpgmod.skill.arrow_rain.desc: Arrows rain on the aimed area for two seconds.
rpgmod.skill.eagle_eye.desc: Gain strength, speed and night vision, and 40 eagle-eye arrows (they vanish if thrown away or put in a chest).
rpgmod.skill.shield_bash.desc: Bash enemies in front, pushing them back and slowing them.
rpgmod.skill.holy_guard.desc: Reduce damage taken by nearby allies.
rpgmod.skill.smite.desc: Call a pillar of light onto the targeted enemy.
rpgmod.skill.lay_on_hands.desc: Heal nearby allies and cure poison.
rpgmod.skill.divine_aegis.desc: Give allies strong resistance and absorption.
rpgmod.skill.judgement.desc: A holy circle spreads, then light strikes every enemy in it.
rpgmod.skill.blink.desc: Teleport up to 10 blocks where you look.
rpgmod.skill.arcane_focus.desc: Restore mana to you and nearby allies.
rpgmod.skill.meteor.desc: Drop a meteor on the aimed spot: a huge fiery blast.
rpgmod.skill.time_warp.desc: Slow time for enemies around you, sapping speed and strength.
rpgmod.skill.magic_bolt.desc: Fire a homing bolt at the enemy you aim at.
rpgmod.skill.flame_burst.desc: Blast a cone of fire ahead, setting enemies alight.
rpgmod.skill.frost_nova.desc: An icy wave spreads out, freezing and slowing enemies.
rpgmod.skill.thunder.desc: Call lightning where you aim; it arcs to nearby enemies.
rpgmod.skill.heal.desc: Spell (cast from the staff): heal yourself and nearby allies.
rpgmod.skill.group_heal.desc: Spell (cast from the staff): heal allies in a wide area (10 blocks).
rpgmod.skill.sanctuary.desc: Create a holy zone for 8 seconds: allies inside heal, enemies inside are slowed and burned.
rpgmod.skill.guardian_light.desc: Give allies absorption, resistance and regeneration.
rpgmod.skill.shadow_step.desc: Appear behind the targeted enemy, or teleport forward.
rpgmod.skill.backstab.desc: A sharp strike on the enemy in front; much stronger from behind.
rpgmod.skill.smoke_bomb.desc: Vanish in smoke and speed up; nearby enemies lose track of you.
rpgmod.skill.assassinate.desc: Appear behind the targeted enemy with a flurry; finishes off weakened enemies.
rpgmod.skill.shadow_dance.desc: Turn invisible and gain strength and speed.
rpgmod.skill.grand_enchant.desc: Give allies strength, resistance and speed.
rpgmod.skill.hex.desc: Heavily weaken and slow enemies around you.
rpgmod.skill.coin_toss.desc: Flip a coin for a random effect (small bet).
rpgmod.skill.lucky_shot.desc: Fire one arrow; sometimes it gets lucky for 2.5x damage.
rpgmod.skill.dice_roll.desc: Roll the dice for a random effect (medium bet).
rpgmod.skill.all_in.desc: Bet everything on a random effect (big bet).
rpgmod.skill.jackpot.desc: Spin the slots for the huge win.
rpgmod.skill.roulette.desc: Spin the wheel of fate: for 12 seconds Lady Luck is with you - every hit is a critical hit, crits deal +10% per number rolled (1-6), and every gamble gets a second roll.
rpgmod.jobselect.title: Choose your job
rpgmod.jobselect.once: You can change later with a Job Change Book

rpgmod.jobscreen.loadout_hint: Pick a slot, then click a skill below to put it there. Ultimates go to the ultimate slot.
rpgmod.jobscreen.hover_hint: Hover a skill to see what it does
rpgmod.jobscreen.unlock_in_panel: Unlock it on the skill panel
rpgmod.jobscreen.spell_hint: Pick a slot and click a spell. Hold %s to switch, right-click to cast.

rpgmod.job.no_spell: No usable spell on this staff
rpgmod.job.need_weapon: Hold one of your job's weapons
rpgmod.job.reset_need: You need %s experience levels to reset
rpgmod.job.panel_migrated: The skill panel changed, your points were refunded
rpgmod.job.bow_restricted: Only rangers and gamblers can use this bow
rpgmod.tooltip.staff_bonus: Magic Attack %1$s, all magic attack x%2$s
rpgmod.skill.intimidate.desc: A heavy slash that lowers enemy attack by 50% for 8s (low damage).
rpgmod.skill.taunt.desc: Every monster within 10 blocks turns on you; you gain resistance.
rpgmod.skill.piercing_shot.desc: A powerful shot that goes through every enemy in a line.
rpgmod.skill.explosive_arrow.desc: An arrow that explodes where it lands (no block damage).
rpgmod.skill.guardian_dome.desc: A dome of light for 12s: monsters cannot get in and enemy projectiles are stopped.
rpgmod.skill.holy_wave.desc: A wave of light rolls forward, hurting enemies and healing allies.
rpgmod.skill.quick_cast.desc: Spells charge 40% faster for 12s (beyond the usual cap).
rpgmod.skill.chrono.desc: Halves the remaining cooldown of all your other skills and spells.
rpgmod.skill.arcane_missiles.desc: Five homing missiles spread over the enemies in front.
rpgmod.skill.blizzard.desc: A 4-second snowstorm on the aimed spot that keeps hurting and slowing.
rpgmod.skill.gravity.desc: Pulls enemies into a gravity well, then crushes them together.
rpgmod.skill.nourish.desc: Restores hunger and saturation to nearby allies.
rpgmod.skill.purify.desc: Removes all harmful effects, fire and freezing from nearby allies, heals a little and smites the enemies around . A spell cast from the staff.
rpgmod.skill.poison_coat.desc: Coats your weapon for 30s; hits apply it. Sneak + key switches it at once: attack down / armour break / venom (5s, 5% of max health a second, undead too, not on bosses).
rpgmod.skill.throwing_knives.desc: Throws five knives in a fan; they carry your coating.
rpgmod.skill.shadow_bind.desc: Shadows pin the targeted enemy in place for 3s and lower its attack.
rpgmod.skill.fire_weapon.desc: The hits of nearby allies set enemies on fire and deal extra damage.
rpgmod.skill.binding_field.desc: A circle on the aimed spot for 5s: enemies inside are heavily slowed and weakened.
rpgmod.skill.russian_roulette.desc: One live round in six. Every click makes the next likelier; the bang deals 1000% attack.
rpgmod.skill.card_throw.desc: Throws three random cards: spade big damage, heart heals, diamond absorption, club poison and slow.

death.attack.rpgmod.skill_magic.player: %1$s was blasted by the magic of %2$s
rpgmod.dragon.stage2.sub: Wing gusts, void orbs and its brood
rpgmod.day.title: Day %s
rpgmod.bloodmoon.title: Blood Moon
rpgmod.bloodmoon.subtitle: No one sleeps tonight...
rpgmod.bloodmoon.no_sleep: You cannot sleep during a blood moon
rpgmod.boss.king_slime.appeared: The blood moon rises... the King Slime appeared near %s!
rpgmod.boss.king_slime.left: Dawn breaks and the King Slime sinks into the ground...
rpgmod.boss.reward: Reward: %s Skill Books (use for +1 skill point, sneak-use for all)
rpgmod.boss.king_slime.absorb: The King Slime is absorbing its small slimes - kill them first!
rpgmod.job.starter_kit: You received a copper weapon and a forging anvil to start with
rpgmod.tooltip.heavy: Heavy weapon: normal hits x%s (skills unaffected)
rpgmod.dragon.guard_takeoff: The dragon shields itself and takes off!
rpgmod.dragon.guard_flight: The dragon is guarding itself - attacks won't get through until it lands
rpgmod.job.guarding: Lower your shield to use skills
rpgmod.roulette.fortune: Lady Luck! Rolled %1$s: every hit crits, crit damage +%2$s%% (%3$ss)
rpgmod.job.berserker.desc: Advanced fighter: throws defence away for raw power.
rpgmod.job.guardian.desc: Advanced paladin: the party's shield, taking every blow.
rpgmod.job.sharpshooter.desc: Advanced ranger: master of sniping and rapid fire.
rpgmod.job.spellmaster.desc: Advanced wizard: four extra left-hand slots on the staff, a spell in each hand at once (right click and the left-hand spell key, left click by default), and fusion of two elements.
rpgmod.job.runemaster.desc: Advanced enchanter: runes that empower allies and weaken foes over a wide area.
rpgmod.job.joker.desc: Advanced gambler: tricks and luck that turn a fight upside down.
rpgmod.job.nightblade.desc: Advanced assassin: with a dagger in the off hand, right click strikes with it too.
rpgmod.job.bishop.desc: Advanced healer: high priest who casts holy attack spells from the staff as well as the heals.
rpgmod.jobscreen.adv_panel_hint: The advanced job's panel. Each advanced level gives one advanced point, spent only here.
rpgmod.job.promoted_sub: Advanced job! The advanced panel is open
rpgmod.job.adv_panel_migrated: The advanced panel changed: your advanced points were refunded
rpgmod.skill.blood_frenzy.desc: Pay 15% of your current health for a big boost to attack and attack speed (Strength II, Haste II).
rpgmod.skill.decapitate.desc: One heavy blow on the enemy in front of you; double damage if it is at half health or less.
rpgmod.skill.triple_whirl.desc: Spin three times, pulling enemies in between; the last spin throws them out.
rpgmod.skill.reckless_charge.desc: A long dash that throws enemies up. For 4s you take 30% more damage.
rpgmod.skill.terror_roar.desc: Enemies within 8 blocks lose much of their attack and speed; your crit rate rises by 25%.
rpgmod.skill.asura.desc: For 15s the lower your health, the harder you hit (up to +150%), and 15% of the damage you deal heals you.
rpgmod.skill.iron_wall.desc: For 8s you take half damage and cannot be knocked back.
rpgmod.skill.provoke_shield.desc: Every monster within 12 blocks turns on you; armour +16 and toughness +8.
rpgmod.skill.cover.desc: For 10s you take 70% of the damage meant for allies within 10 blocks.
rpgmod.skill.shield_wall.desc: Raises a wall of light 9 blocks wide just ahead: it stops enemy projectiles and holds monsters back.
rpgmod.skill.reprisal.desc: For 8s, monsters hitting you in melee take 15% of your attack plus a third of their hit back.
rpgmod.skill.bastion.desc: Allies within 10 blocks get Resistance III (-60% damage) and absorption; for 12s your health cannot drop below 1.
rpgmod.skill.snipe.desc: Aim for half a second, then a shot that ignores armour along your crosshair (64 blocks).
rpgmod.skill.rapid_fire.desc: Fires eight arrows in about a second wherever you aim.
rpgmod.skill.weak_point.desc: Exposes the targeted enemy: it takes 60% more damage (enemies within 4 blocks of it +30%), and glows.
rpgmod.skill.ricochet.desc: A shot that bounces from enemy to enemy - up to five hits, a little weaker each time.
rpgmod.skill.roll.desc: Roll back low; the next arrow from your bow within 6s hits two and a half times as hard.
rpgmod.skill.dead_eye.desc: Marks every enemy in sight within 40 blocks and fires a homing shot at each one (at least four shots, shared out when there are few).
rpgmod.skill.double_cast.desc: For 15s your next two spells go off a second time, free.
rpgmod.skill.mana_overload.desc: For 12s magic attack is x1.5 - but spells cost 50% more mana.
rpgmod.skill.mana_well.desc: A spring under your feet: allies standing in it regain mana every second (8s).
rpgmod.skill.phase_shift.desc: Teleport 14 blocks where you look; untouchable for 1.5s as you come out.
rpgmod.skill.arcane_seal.desc: A seal on the aimed spot: enemies inside are slowed and take 30% more damage (8s).
rpgmod.skill.armageddon.desc: Ten meteors rain down on the aimed area (12 blocks) over four seconds; half of them go for enemies.
rpgmod.skill.inferno.desc: Hellfire bursts up on the aimed spot, and the ground keeps burning for 4s.
rpgmod.skill.absolute_zero.desc: Everything around the aimed spot (7 blocks) freezes solid for 3s.
rpgmod.skill.thunderstorm.desc: A storm cloud over the aimed area brings six bolts down on the enemies below in 3s.
rpgmod.skill.stone_spikes.desc: Stone spikes burst out of the ground in a 14-block line, throwing enemies up.
rpgmod.skill.radiant_lance.desc: A lance of light through every enemy in a line.
rpgmod.skill.dark_orb.desc: A slow orb of darkness that tears at and pulls in everything it passes, then bursts.
rpgmod.skill.tornado.desc: A whirlwind that crawls forward, lifting and grinding the enemies it catches (4s).
rpgmod.skill.starfall.desc: Stars rain down on the aimed area for three seconds.
rpgmod.skill.earth_rune.desc: A rune on the aimed ground: enemies on it are slowed, weakened and ground down (8s).
rpgmod.skill.ward_rune.desc: A rune of protection under you: allies on it get resistance and regeneration (10s).
rpgmod.skill.gale_rune.desc: Nearby allies run much faster and jump higher.
rpgmod.skill.night_sight.desc: Gives nearby allies night vision and water breathing for a long time.
rpgmod.skill.feather_rune.desc: Nearby allies take no fall damage for 2 minutes.
rpgmod.skill.grand_rune.desc: A huge circle (12 blocks, 15s): allies inside get strength, resistance, speed and regeneration; enemies are slowed, weakened and hurt.
rpgmod.skill.switcheroo.desc: Trade places with the targeted enemy, leaving it dazed for 3s.
rpgmod.skill.decoy.desc: Leave a decoy and vanish: monsters go for it, and after 5s it blows up.
rpgmod.skill.loaded_dice.desc: Your next gamble within 30s (coin, dice, roulette, cards...) lands on its best result.
rpgmod.skill.card_storm.desc: Cards whirl around you for 3s, hitting nearby enemies with random suit effects.
rpgmod.skill.vanish.desc: Reappear behind the targeted enemy and stay unseen by monsters for 3s. Your next hit is doubled (and reveals you).
rpgmod.skill.wildcard.desc: Unleash a random ultimate from any job, with your own strength.
rpgmod.skill.shadow_run.desc: Dash 9 blocks through the shadows, cutting every enemy in the way.
rpgmod.skill.flurry.desc: Six quick cuts in front of you in one second.
rpgmod.skill.twin_venom.desc: For 15s your melee hits inflict strong venom (7.5% of max health a second, not on bosses) and wither.
rpgmod.skill.shadow_stitch.desc: A kunai pins the targeted enemy's shadow - and those of enemies within 4 blocks - for 3s.
rpgmod.skill.moon_shadow.desc: A crescent of moonlight flies forward, cutting every enemy in its path.
rpgmod.skill.yaksha.desc: For 12s every melee hit strikes twice, and you move faster.
rpgmod.skill.revive_prayer.desc: Raises downed allies within 12 blocks on the spot (half health); heals the others. Costs 10 experience levels (only usable with someone downed).
rpgmod.skill.divine_domain.desc: Holy ground under you (10s): allies on it take 30% less damage and are cleansed.
rpgmod.skill.great_miracle.desc: Every ally within 30 blocks is raised, fully healed and cleansed, and gets Resistance II and Regeneration II.
rpgmod.skill.holy_nova.desc: A ring of light bursts out: enemies are struck, allies healed.
rpgmod.skill.light_pillar.desc: A column of light on the aimed spot that keeps striking for 2.5s.
rpgmod.skill.steam_burst.desc: Fusion (fire + ice): steam explodes on the aimed spot, throwing enemies back, blinding and slowing them.
rpgmod.skill.plasma_ray.desc: Fusion (fire + thunder): a plasma ray through every enemy in a line; each one hit arcs to others nearby.
rpgmod.skill.frost_tempest.desc: Fusion (ice + thunder): a freezing storm over the aimed area; enemies inside freeze and lightning keeps falling.
rpgmod.jobscreen.hands_legend: R: right click  L: left-hand key
rpgmod.wheel.hint_hands: Left ring: left hand, right ring: right hand
rpgmod.skill.holy_light.desc: A shaft of light falls on the targeted enemy (a little splash around it).
rpgmod.skill.holy_barrier.desc: A shield of absorption for nearby allies, thicker the higher your magic attack (+4 per 8 magic attack, up to 20).
rpgmod.skill.guardian_angel.desc: The most wounded ally within 12 blocks (you included) cannot fall for 5s and gets Regeneration II.

rpgmod.boss.golem.appeared: The blood moon rises... the Golem appeared near %s!
rpgmod.boss.golem.enraged: The Golem's core is glowing red-hot!
rpgmod.boss.golem.armour: The Golem raised its stone armour - break the glowing pillars!
rpgmod.boss.golem.left: Dawn breaks and the Golem crumbles back into the ground...
rpgmod.eagle_arrow.lore: Vanishes if thrown away or put in a chest
rpgmod.jobchange.title: Change job
rpgmod.jobchange.no_book: You have no Job Change Book
rpgmod.jobchange.locked_desc: The advanced job beyond the %1$s. Master it (100%%) to reveal and choose it (now %2$s%%).
rpgmod.jobchange.mastered: %1$s mastered! You got a Job Change Book - use it to become a %2$s
rpgmod.job.pirate.desc: A pirate with a gunblade: shoots from range and stabs up close (stabbing reloads the gun). Cannons and powder kegs on top.
rpgmod.job.lancer.desc: Rules the distance with a long spear: hits with the far end hit harder. Charges and throws.
rpgmod.job.monk.desc: A fist fighter: hits build ki, the big moves spend it. Parries and counters.
rpgmod.job.bard.desc: Plays songs for the party around them. Clicking in time with the notes makes the song stronger (no attacking while playing).
rpgmod.skill.boarding_shot.desc: Lunge in with the bayonet, then fire point-blank. Reloads one round.
rpgmod.skill.quick_draw.desc: Empty the gun in a burst (at least three shots).
rpgmod.skill.cannon.desc: Set down a cannon that shells nearby enemies for 10s. Its power follows your attack.
rpgmod.skill.powder_keg.desc: Throw a keg that blows up after 2s - or at once when shot. Does not break blocks.
rpgmod.skill.grapple.desc: Pull the targeted enemy to you - or, with no enemy, swing to where you aim.
rpgmod.skill.rum.desc: A swig: heals a little and attacks faster for 8s.
rpgmod.skill.broadside.desc: Shells fly over your head from behind and carpet-bomb the aimed area row by row, near to far.
rpgmod.skill.jolly_roger.desc: Plant the flag: 15s of more attack for allies around it, faster cannons and endless rounds for you.
rpgmod.skill.lance_charge.desc: Charge, faster and faster, carrying the enemies you skewer (up to three); at the end they are flung off, harder the faster you went. Into a wall: a heavy hit and a stun.
rpgmod.skill.spear_throw.desc: Throw the spear through a line of enemies. It comes back.
rpgmod.skill.spear_sweep.desc: A wide arc in front of you that throws enemies back.
rpgmod.skill.leap_thrust.desc: Plant the spear and vault onto the aimed spot; the landing sends a shockwave running straight on, throwing up whoever it passes.
rpgmod.skill.counter_stance.desc: Brace for 2s: enemies that come close or hit you are struck back (you take half damage).
rpgmod.skill.dragon_fang.desc: Leap straight up and come down spinning the spear; the landing throws the enemies around high into the air (nearer ones harder).
rpgmod.skill.spear_rain.desc: Spears rain on the aimed area for 3s and stay stuck in the ground, then all burst at once (more damage per spear nearby, up to four).
rpgmod.skill.combo.desc: Three quick punches in front of you. Each hit builds ki.
rpgmod.skill.ki_blast.desc: Spend all your ki on one strike: +80% power per point.
rpgmod.skill.parry.desc: For 1.2s the next melee hit is turned aside and answered. Success gives 2 ki.
rpgmod.skill.whirl_kick.desc: A spinning kick that knocks enemies around you away. Ki for each hit (up to 2).
rpgmod.skill.meditate.desc: Stand still for 3s: heal 8% of max health a second and fill your ki.
rpgmod.skill.shrink_step.desc: Blink behind the enemy you aim at and strike its back (x1.3), leaving an afterimage. +1 ki.
rpgmod.skill.hundred_fists.desc: A storm of punches in front of you for 3s.
rpgmod.skill.diamond_body.desc: For 6s: 80% less damage, no knockback, and every hit builds ki.
rpgmod.skill.war_song.desc: Play for 12s: allies around you deal more damage.
rpgmod.skill.heal_song.desc: Play for 12s: allies around you heal every second.
rpgmod.skill.guard_song.desc: Play for 12s: allies around you take less damage.
rpgmod.skill.wind_song.desc: Play for 12s: allies around you move and attack faster.
rpgmod.skill.discord.desc: Play for 12s: enemies around you take sound damage every second and lose armour.
rpgmod.skill.lullaby.desc: Play for 12s: enemies around you grow drowsy - slow and weak.
rpgmod.skill.grand_concert.desc: For 10s, all four songs (war, healing, guard, wind) at full strength at once.
rpgmod.skill.finale.desc: End the performance with a shockwave as big as the combo you built.
rpgmod.jobchange.soon_desc: The %1$s has no advanced job yet.
rpgmod.jobchange.no_advanced: This job has no advanced job yet
rpgmod.job.captain.desc: The pirate's advanced job: two cannons at once, orders to the crew and heavy shots.
rpgmod.job.champion.desc: The monk's advanced job: holds up to seven ki and spends it on secret arts.
rpgmod.job.dragoon.desc: The lancer's advanced job: leaps high and dives on the enemy spear first.
rpgmod.job.maestro.desc: The bard's advanced job: plays two songs at once and modulates between them.
rpgmod.job.spellblade.desc: Fights with fire, ice or thunder on the sword. Hold right click with the sword to charge a spell of the element (fire: fireball, ice: wide area, thunder: one target). Skills scale with attack + magic attack.
rpgmod.job.qi_master.desc: Fights with fists and ki, and heals with it too.
rpgmod.job.sentinel.desc: Holds the line with a spear and a shield in the off hand, striking back.
rpgmod.job.spellsinger.desc: Songs that put magic on the party's weapons. Plays like the bard.
rpgmod.job.shadow_hunter.desc: Bow and dagger. A hit from hiding is always a critical hit.
rpgmod.job.treasure_hunter.desc: Lucky cannons and more loot. Can fire the gunblade like the pirate.
rpgmod.skill.twin_cannon.desc: Set a second cannon on your other side (two shells per shot). Works alongside the first.
rpgmod.skill.anchor_throw.desc: Throw the anchor: enemies around where it lands are dragged in and slowed.
rpgmod.skill.rally.desc: Faster attacks and movement for allies around you.
rpgmod.skill.deadshot.desc: Aim for half a second, then one heavy shot. Uses three rounds.
rpgmod.skill.fleet_barrage.desc: Three ghost ships appear in the sky behind you and take turns shooting the enemies in the area for 5s; your cannons fire flat out meanwhile.
rpgmod.skill.rising_dragon.desc: Uppercut that launches enemies. +1 ki on a hit.
rpgmod.skill.ki_wave.desc: A beam through a line of enemies, spending all ki (+80% per point).
rpgmod.skill.iron_mountain.desc: Gather for a moment, then a shoulder slam that sends the enemy flying into the others behind it; into a wall it is stunned. +1 ki.
rpgmod.skill.foresight.desc: For 3s every melee hit is dodged and answered (+1 ki each).
rpgmod.skill.battle_aura.desc: For 12s, +4% damage per point of ki.
rpgmod.skill.peerless.desc: Spend all ki: 3 + 2 per ki strikes, the last one huge.
rpgmod.skill.high_jump.desc: Leap high and hang there 1.5s (untouchable), aiming with the reticle; dive onto one enemy for a heavy blow (a little to those right next to it).
rpgmod.skill.dragon_spear.desc: Throw a spear that explodes on impact.
rpgmod.skill.spiral_lance.desc: Four drilling thrusts that drag enemies onto the spear.
rpgmod.skill.sky_step.desc: A jump off thin air. No fall damage.
rpgmod.skill.dragon_king.desc: Rise high, then dive inside a phantom dragon onto a wide area; the ground burns for 4s, burning enemies in it.
rpgmod.skill.duet.desc: For 12s the next song plays alongside the current one.
rpgmod.skill.modulate.desc: Switch the song being played to the next one, same time and points (+4 points).
rpgmod.skill.heroic_song.desc: A big boost for the ally you look at (or yourself): +30% damage, toughness, speed.
rpgmod.skill.requiem.desc: For 10s, everyone around (the downed too) heals 4% of max health a second.
rpgmod.skill.shock_chord.desc: A chord that hits everything around and stuns it briefly.
rpgmod.skill.symphony.desc: For 12s, all four songs at full strength and damage to enemies around each second.
rpgmod.skill.element_shift.desc: Switch the sword's element: fire, ice, thunder.
rpgmod.skill.magic_slash.desc: A flying slash of the element. Fire: a spinning wheel of flame that bursts on the first thing it meets. Ice: a wide, slow crescent along the ground, through everyone, slowing them for a moment. Thunder: strikes the first enemy at once and jumps on to three more.
rpgmod.skill.thunder_thrust.desc: Become lightning and be at the end of the line at once (untouchable); a moment later lightning strikes all along the path.
rpgmod.skill.frost_blade.desc: A freezing sweep in front that slows.
rpgmod.skill.flame_wheel.desc: Spin twice in flames, setting everything around on fire.
rpgmod.skill.spell_guard.desc: For 6s, −30% damage taken; attackers get the element back.
rpgmod.skill.arcane_edge.desc: One huge slash wrapped in the element.
rpgmod.skill.elemental_burst.desc: Fire, ice and thunder burst out around you in turn.
rpgmod.skill.qi_bullet.desc: A ball of ki; +80% when one ki is spent.
rpgmod.skill.refine_qi.desc: For 4s, ki builds each second and health regenerates.
rpgmod.skill.healing_palm.desc: Heal yourself and allies around. +1 ki.
rpgmod.skill.hard_qi.desc: Spend all ki on a hard shell (more ki, less damage taken) and a little health.
rpgmod.skill.qi_burst.desc: Drive ki into the enemies in front; a third of the damage heals you.
rpgmod.skill.flowing_step.desc: Weave between up to three nearby enemies, striking each; every touch heals 4%. +1 ki.
rpgmod.skill.heaven_earth.desc: A big heal for everyone around, and enemies blown away.
rpgmod.skill.blooming_fists.desc: 3s of punches; every hit heals you.
rpgmod.skill.guard_thrust.desc: A straight thrust, then 2s of raised guard.
rpgmod.skill.shield_charge.desc: Charge behind the shield, pushing up to five enemies along; drive them into a wall to stun them (2.5s) for a heavy hit, else they are shoved off.
rpgmod.skill.immovable.desc: For 6s, −40% damage taken and no knockback (slower).
rpgmod.skill.spear_wall.desc: Plant a ring of spears for 8s; enemies inside are struck and pushed out.
rpgmod.skill.counter_lance.desc: Brace behind the shield for 3s: blows do 60% less, and what the shield took is stored x4 (up to a cap). Your next melee hit within 6s after carries it all.
rpgmod.skill.provoke.desc: Every enemy around turns on you; you brace.
rpgmod.skill.fortress.desc: For 10s, −50% damage taken for allies around; you cannot be moved.
rpgmod.skill.holy_lance.desc: A spear of light through everything straight ahead.
rpgmod.skill.flame_melody.desc: Play for 12s: allies' hits burn and hit harder.
rpgmod.skill.haste_tune.desc: Play for 12s: allies attack and move faster.
rpgmod.skill.mana_chord.desc: Play for 12s: allies regain mana each second.
rpgmod.skill.seal_melody.desc: Play for 12s: enemies around are exposed and slowed.
rpgmod.skill.thunder_tune.desc: Play for 12s: lightning strikes an enemy around each second.
rpgmod.skill.resonance.desc: Every good effect on allies around lasts 5s longer; +4 points if playing.
rpgmod.skill.grand_concerto.desc: For 10s, the flame, haste and mana songs at full strength at once.
rpgmod.skill.sealing_chord.desc: End the performance with a shockwave that leaves enemies exposed.
rpgmod.skill.vital_shot.desc: A shot along the crosshair; double damage on enemies at half health or less.
rpgmod.skill.stealth.desc: Vanish and lose the monsters. The next hit is a sure crit, +60%.
rpgmod.skill.shadow_arrow.desc: An arrow that pins the enemy in place.
rpgmod.skill.hunter_trap.desc: Set a trap for 20s: the first enemy to step on it sets it off.
rpgmod.skill.shadow_leap.desc: Leap back out of a smoke puff; nearby enemies are blinded, the next hit is an ambush.
rpgmod.skill.night_hunt.desc: For 10s you are unseen and every enemy around is prey (+50% damage from you).
rpgmod.skill.shadow_rain.desc: Shadow arrows fall on one enemy for 3s, pinning it; each one glances off to the nearest other enemy (half damage), pinning it too.
rpgmod.skill.gamble_cannon.desc: A random shell: explosive, ice, poison, gold, a dud or the jackpot. Luck rerolls a dud.
rpgmod.skill.coin_shot.desc: Eight gold coins fired in a spread.
rpgmod.skill.mimic.desc: A chest that lures monsters in and bites them (8s).
rpgmod.skill.steal.desc: Strike the enemy in front with a chance to steal treasure (once per monster).
rpgmod.skill.lucky_compass.desc: For 60s, more luck and monsters drop extra treasure.
rpgmod.skill.double_down.desc: For 6s every hit is doubled or halved (luck helps).
rpgmod.skill.treasure_rain.desc: Gold coins rain on the aimed area for 3s. Some stay on the ground; a player who picks one up gets gold rush (+5% damage, stacks to five, 10s).
rpgmod.skill.golden_cannon.desc: A golden cannonball and a huge blast; half again as big with luck.
rpgmod.jobchange.hybrid_locked: A hybrid job that opens once both %1$s and %2$s are mastered (%3$s%% / %4$s%%).
rpgmod.skill.mana_share.desc: Spend 20% of your maximum mana; every ally within 24 blocks gets twice that (not yourself).
rpgmod.skill.mana_meditate.desc: Sit and meditate: mana comes back much faster (up to 15s). Ends when used again, or when you move, attack or use another skill.
